    """Expand a centered marker into a downward V and periodic diagonal bands."""

    for r in range(n):
        if r <= center:
            for c in {center - r, center + r}:
                if 0 <= c < n:
                    out[r][c] = 2

    # The remaining diagonals form bands every four columns, phased at the marker.
    for r in range(n):
